Florida Center

Large mall in the south-eastern area, useful for varied shopping, services and family outings with good urban connectivity.

Best for

  • Families
  • Variety
  • Practical shopping

Not ideal for

  • Tourists staying far away with little time

Getting there

Close to Mirador station.

Recommended time: 2–3 hours
